title: Wren and the Lantern
author: Cyrus Fairweather
blurb: Wendell Nystrom, a typeface cutter's daughter in a print shop on the eve of a revolution, believes history happens to other people, elsewhere. But when the census taker asks one question too many, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must smuggle the evidence past three checkpoints before the armistice is signed — or isn't.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
